outcome: length of stay (LOS) of the child
cohort: 65 women with GDM and 60 women without GDM
finding: This study found that women with GDM had a longer length of stay for both mother and child, were more likely to deliver by Cesarean section, and had normal gestational weight gain compared to women without GDM.
mod_finding: Women with GDM were significantly more likely to deliver by cesarean section compared to women without GDM.
